v2_observation.san: After switching to 7d or 90d, circles are offset from the polyline

root_cause_assessment: TrendChart linePoints recomputes from reactive data, while circle/text render calls getX(idx) and getY(point.value) read data/maxValue/minValue only inside the methods. The inline child template was omitted from the hidden-reactive-dependency validator. The v3 correction was subsequently confirmed by user manual review of the reported period-switch geometry issue.
generic_prevention: The hidden-template-reactive-dependency validator now checks inline san.defineComponent templates; the focused computed repair prompt requires explicit reactive arguments in render calls and synchronized method signatures.
